purpose: Artwork resources, not a gameplay implementation.

hp.percentageLayer: Above gauge fill and frame; fixed at gauge center, independent of filled width.

cast.timeLayer: Above gauge fill and frame; fixed at gauge center.

target.visibleWhen: Actual target is known; update from game data.

gaugeGeometry.ratio: HP: current / max. Cast: elapsed / duration; show remaining time separately.
gaugeGeometry.atFull: Use full inner polygon; hide moving tip highlight.
gaugeGeometry.clipping: Preserve full-width texture. Reveal with a rectangle plus pointed leading edge and intersect with the inner polygon.
gaugeGeometry.warning: Horizontal rectangle cropping alone produces a blunt leading edge.

runtime.bossName: Replace sample; shorten or reduce font before colliding with title ornaments.
runtime.hp: Display percentage centered inside the full gauge. Keep text separate from the fill mask and stationary as HP changes.
runtime.casting: Center skill name above gauge, and remaining time inside gauge. Keep time separate from fill mask. Hide the complete cast group when not casting.
runtime.target: Sample player name is illustrative. Reposition marker/label as a group if target text is longer.
runtime.stageDifficulty: Sample STAGE 01 · NORMAL; actual state drives these labels.

examples.notice: Cast name, time and target are display samples; not balance or combat specifications.
